text_block_list.text:
—Christmas.
A night where holy bells echo from afar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas... *death*...
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet.
Though I'm close to my limit... *urgh*...

Even though it was Christmas,
Mejiro Ryan looked like she was having a rough time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is coming up soon...
It's already an intense race packed with stars as it is, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This year is Oguri-san's last run. She's strong
ordinarily, but she'll be peaking with nothing
left in reserve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Umamusume fans all across Japan
are wishing for Oguri-san's victory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"We have to crush that
and win, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought competing against McQueen
had gotten me used to the pressure. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's nothing like that this time. It feels like there's a mini dump truck sitting right on my chest.
Mejiro Ryan looked truly heartbroken.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, Trainer,
it's time for a desperation party!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's binge on carbs like crazy,
huff and puff and dance it out, and just forget everything!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't take any more! My heart's weight capacity
is completely overloaded!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, hustle those muscles
with me! Hyahaaa!!
Just as a party destined to ruin one's health was about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait...
Who could it be at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Ryan-chan♪
Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ines!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Weren't you resting at the sanatorium right now?
Did you come all this way just to check on me?"
That was Ines Fujin, her roommate who ran the Derby with her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why
you were about to stress-eat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… I just feel like nothing good will
come from beating the biggest superstar,
Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I get how you feel,
but is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone has their own idea
of who they want to win, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Each of us?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Lately I haven't been in the best shape,
so I've been rehabbing at the hot springs, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, seeing Ryan-chan working so hard
makes me want to return to racing soon."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seeing Ryan-chan, who ran with me in the Derby, giving it her all makes me feel like I'm giving it my all, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I like Oguri-san, but...
my number one star is—Ryan-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I really want her to win. The person who wants Ryan-chan
to win most in the world is right here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Me, and Trainer too.
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines...
Trainer...

Ines Fujin handed over some onsen manju
and heartfelt words before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I was wrong, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Oguri-san's brilliance,
I ended up losing sight of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the first star too!! That's what I want to be,
and there are people wishing for it too!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What I'm carrying on my shoulders is no different
from what Oguri-san is carrying. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
And then, I will claim it—the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to show everyone!!
Me conquering both Grand Prix races, Takarazuka and Arima!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to show everyone!!
Me conquering both Grand Prix races, Takarazuka and Arima!

Furthermore—there were others who fervently
wished for Mejiro Ryan's victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wh-what?

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hello! We're all members of the Ryan Fan Club, here ever since we were little kids!

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best!
We're all rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, who's the person next to you again? What are the two of you doing together on Christmas Eve?

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a party with just the two of us?
How about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, no, that's!
I mean, sure, I was going to do that, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No comment beyond this!! For anything else,
...please speak through my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aaaaah, you were right next to me!?
Please don't mention what happened just now~~~!!

Mejiro Ryan's popularity was so high that people even chased her in private.
She was right up there with Oguri Cap.
